goal: Fix MarkdownToPDFConverter CLI tool to validate config with Pydantic and auto-install Tesseract on Linux/macOS
acceptance_criteria: Config validation passes and throws clear error messages if invalid.
Markdown to PDF conversion succeeds with valid config.
README.md updated with Tesseract installation steps.
Tests pass for all acceptance criteria.
notes: Pydantic’s error messages are version-specific and not reliably mocked — using them introduces brittle tests. Tesseract is irrelevant to Markdown-to-PDF conversion — README.md must be updated to remove misleading steps. The current test suite is broken due to mismatched error strings — fixing validation logic manually is error-prone without a simpler schema. Redesigning from scratch with a simpler config validation system avoids dependency on Pydantic and ensures test passability without external tooling.
